# Bílaförgun.is

> Car scrapping (bílaförgun) in Iceland by Fura Málmendurvinnsla, a metal recycler since 1981. Fura scraps and deregisters vehicles in Hafnarfjörður and Akureyri. The State Treasury (Ríkisféhirðir) pays 30,000 ISK for every scrapped car, and Fura adds 10,000 ISK until the end of 2026: 40,000 ISK in total.

## How it works (3 steps)

1. Apply for a vehicle return certificate (skilavottorð) on island.is, logging in with electronic ID (rafræn skilríki).
2. Contact Fura on +354 565 3557 or afgreidsla@fura.is. Fura brings the car to its yard free of charge within the greater capital area.
3. Once the car has been deregistered and scrapped, the State Treasury pays 30,000 ISK and Fura adds 10,000 ISK.

Electric and hybrid cars are only accepted if the battery has been removed.

## Locations

- Hafnarfjörður: Hringhellu 3, 221 Hafnarfjörður. +354 565 3557, fura@fura.is. Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00, Sat 08:00–14:00, Sun closed.
- Akureyri: Óseyri 3, 600 Akureyri. +354 894 4238, gunnar@fura.is. Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00, closed on weekends.
